# Stash Domain Models

*Navigation: [[index|← StashStats Index]] / [[models-overview|Domain Models]] / Stash Domain Models*
*Siblings: [[models-yarn|Yarn Models]] · [[models-project|Project Models]]*

The stash data model represents individual user inventory items and their skein purchase allocations.

## Skein Pack Model

`Pack` captures specific purchase lots, dye lots, skein weights, and project assignments:

```{.python include="../src/stashstats/models/stash.py" snippet="pack-model"}
```

## Stash Item Model

`StashItem` is the primary inventory model returned across list and search endpoints:

```{.python include="../src/stashstats/models/stash.py" snippet="stash-item-model"}
```

## Normalization Strategy

When a stash entry has a single `primary_pack` but an empty `packs` array, `normalize_packs_and_quantities` automatically wraps the primary pack into the `packs` collection and copies missing yardage/gram values to top-level properties.
